items.prompt: The public EMA uses alpha=2/(span+1). For span=3 and previous state 10, what weight belongs to the new price?

options.why: That would use span/(span+1), not the specified smoothing formula.
This treats the EMA as an equal-weight three-observation average.
alpha=2/(3+1)=1/2; the old state also receives weight 1/2.
The numerator alone is not the weight; divide by span+1.
